edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the forwarded transfer.
transfer passes recipient parameter _to to transferFrom.
transfer passes amount parameter _value to transferFrom.
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier which whitelists callers.
transferFrom checks msg.sender against _from to decide allowance consumption.
transferFrom reads balanceOf and allowance for _from.
transferFrom credits balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom uses _value for balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for source and recipient.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance subtraction.
approve sets allowance for msg.sender over the spender.
approve uses spender parameter as allowance key.
approve writes _value into the allowance mapping.
approve directly overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
delegate compares the caller against the owner state variable.
delegate invokes the low-level delegatecall unsafe operation.
delegate passes arbitrary target address a to delegatecall.
delegate passes arbitrary calldata b to delegatecall.
delegatecall executes code of the attacker-controlled address a in this storage context.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend compares caller against owner state variable.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for sender and each recipient.
batchSend iterates over the recipient array _tos.
batchSend uses _value for per-recipient credits.
batchSend derives total from _value and _tos.length for the balance check.
batchSend loop is bounded by index i.
batchSend loop assigns _tos[i] to local _to.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
pairFor hashes the factory parameter into the pair address.
pairFor sorts and hashes tokenA.
pairFor sorts and hashes tokenB.
pairFor assigns the computed address to pair and returns it.
ensure validates the _from address parameter.
ensure validates the _to address parameter.
ensure requires _from or _to to equal owner.
ensure compares _from against the locally computed Uniswap pair UNI.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted pair address.
constructor stores _name into the name state variable.
constructor stores _symbol into the symbol state variable.
constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals into totalSupply.
constructor writes the name state variable.
constructor writes the symbol state variable.
constructor sets totalSupply.
constructor reads decimals to scale the supply.
constructor assigns ownership to the deployer.
constructor uses msg.sender as owner and initial balance holder.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router address.
